faq: What is a retail POS system?
A retail point of sale system is an integrated platform that combines software and hardware to facilitate and manage sales transactions in retail environments.
How do I choose a retail POS system?
To choose a retail point of sale, profile your business.
Embedded POS payments work by directly and automatically transmitting sale data from the POS system to the payment terminal.
Why should I use Lightspeed Retail POS system for my business?
You should use Lightspeed because we can help you go further.
Can I manage multiple stores using Lightspeed?
Yes, Lightspeed’s enterprise POS system was designed to make managing multiple stores straightforward.
Can you migrate my current inventory and customer data into the Lightspeed Retail POS software? How easy is the migration process of our data onto your POS?
Yes, we can help migrate your data.
